headline: Quiet day: Google in talks to join Pentagon's Golden Dome programme
body: A quiet Saturday. Bloomberg reported Google is in talks with the Pentagon to help secure data for the $185 billion Golden Dome missile-defense programme, which plans heavy use of AI and autonomy, lifting Catastrophic Risk by 0.12. Self-Destruction rose slightly. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance slipped to -9.90 from -9.86.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.1, from Google's Golden Dome talks (+0.16), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04). Descendants -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11). Zookeeper -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11).
